voice: Three menu words blending sensory detail with evocative character; category and ordering are flexible.
basis: Predicted from current authored recipes, methods, flavour checks and available studio dialogue. These are editorial descriptions, not results from tasting the drinks.

sourceCoverage.legacyContext: The three original approved pours have their rationale and lineage in their dossiers and the studio rulebook.

cocktails.caption: Gracious · Zesty · Aromatic
cocktails.rationale: Fresh lime anchors the Gimlet; caraway supplies aroma. The cordial made ahead for someone gives Gracious its place.

cocktails.caption: Curious · Malty · Fizzy
cocktails.rationale: Unpeated blended Scotch keeps the grain character; hops add a beer-like accent and soda brings bubbles. Curious fits the experimental lineage.

cocktails.caption: Comforting · Honeyed · Herbal
cocktails.rationale: A hot whiskey-and-honey cup carries the scent of briefly steeped thyme. Comforting describes the welcoming gesture of someone making it for you.

cocktails.caption: Graceful · Fruity · Sparkling
cocktails.rationale: Blackcurrant and basil meet dry sparkling wine. Graceful evokes the gently built glass and the person who changes a room quietly.

cocktails.caption: Playful · Gingery · Fizzy
cocktails.rationale: Cooked ginger, cumin, lime and soda make an aromatic long drink. Playful belongs to the well-timed humour around its story.

cocktails.caption: Devoted · Rounded · Fruity
cocktails.rationale: Passion-fruit syrup rounds a Scotch cocktail with bitters and lemon oil. Devoted comes from the small, attentive addition to a familiar order.

cocktails.caption: Radiant · Citrusy · Bittersweet
cocktails.rationale: Orange amer and sweet orange-peel syrup keep bitter and sweet together; soda adds sparkle. Radiant carries that orange brightness and the hopeful reading.

cocktails.caption: Feisty · Zesty · Fizzy
cocktails.rationale: Gin, lemon and soda keep the Collins bright; jaggery adds darker sugar notes. Feisty evokes the purposeful sugar swap and speaking up.

cocktails.caption: Generous · Roasty · Creamy
cocktails.rationale: Hot coffee and Irish whiskey sit under toasted-oat cream. Generous evokes the hospitality of the drink rather than its portion size.

cocktails.caption: Sociable · Tangy · Rumish
cocktails.rationale: Rum remains perceptible in a long, still grog; lime and sherry vinegar provide tang. Sociable fits a measured drink made to let the evening last.

cocktails.caption: Assured · Herbal · Rounded
cocktails.rationale: Old Tom gin, sweet vermouth and bitters make a rounded Martinez-like drink. Assured fits the considered choice of an older gin style.

cocktails.caption: Intimate · Herbal · Velvety
cocktails.rationale: Gin and a little Fernet give herbal depth; vermouth and stirring give smoothness. Intimate comes from fitting the measure to one person.

cocktails.caption: Adventurous · Bittersweet · Aromatic
cocktails.rationale: Aromatic bitters form the core, balanced by lemon and lemongrass syrup. Adventurous reflects the open spirit slot and deliberate experiment.

cocktails.caption: Dreamy · Creamy · Floral
cocktails.rationale: Cream and egg white build the cloudlike fizz; orange flower water supplies a floral accent. Dreamy belongs to both the glass and the Visionary's imagination.

cocktails.caption: Effortless · Zesty · Clean
cocktails.rationale: Blanco tequila, lime and blue-agave syrup make a stripped-back Margarita. Effortless describes the finished impression, despite the care behind it.

cocktails.caption: Mischievous · Fruity · Tangy
cocktails.rationale: Tomato-vanilla syrup tastes of ripe red fruit first, brightened by rum and lime, with a slight savoury undertone. Mischievous evokes its strawberry-daiquiri expectation being gently overturned.

cocktails.caption: Mesmerising · Aniseed · Silky
cocktails.rationale: Absinthe's anise and bitter herbs meet cranberry syrup and cold water. The changing louche earns Mesmerising; Silky refers to the diluted anise-oil texture.

cocktails.caption: Enchanting · Tart · Silky
cocktails.rationale: Tamarind, lime and tea remain after milk clarification gives the rum punch a soft body. Enchanting evokes its overnight transformation.

cocktails.caption: Liberating · Fruity · Tart
cocktails.rationale: Citrus and cranberry stay deliberately tart, with basil as a green accent. Liberating comes from the invitation to enjoy your own taste openly.

cocktails.caption: Nostalgic · Floral · Tart
cocktails.rationale: Violet liqueur scents the gin-and-lemon sour, with maraschino beneath it. Nostalgic evokes keeping an ordinary moment as it was.

cocktails.caption: Commanding · Citrusy · Rounded
cocktails.rationale: Cognac, orange and lemon give the Sidecar spine; honey rounds it and a dash of olive brine seasons it. Commanding reflects the deliberate composition.

cocktails.caption: Refined · Herbal · Spiced
cocktails.rationale: Rye and aromatic bitters carry warm spice; green Chartreuse adds herbs in the seasoning slot. Refined evokes revisiting an old drink through one considered change.

cocktails.caption: Delicate · Fruity · Herbal
cocktails.rationale: Blanco tequila and blanc vermouth meet just a teaspoon of peach liqueur. Delicate describes the small fruit accent and the restraint of leaving flowers alone.

cocktails.caption: Inventive · Zesty · Frosty
cocktails.rationale: A frozen Margarita base gains vanilla beside the orange, with fresh lime added for serving. Inventive comes from solving the freezing and dilution in advance.

cocktails.caption: Intrepid · Caramelised · Spiced
cocktails.rationale: Deep-amber caramel syrup seasons a single-barrel bourbon Old-Fashioned with bitters. Intrepid evokes being first to step forward.

cocktails.caption: Wonderstruck · Fruity · Rounded
cocktails.rationale: White rum, blanc vermouth, Madeira and orange curaçao give layered fruit and mellow wine depth. Wonderstruck evokes noticing something worth pausing for.

cocktails.caption: Eccentric · Malty · Toasty
cocktails.rationale: Malty ale and aged rum meet darkened sugar in a hot flip without egg. Eccentric fits the elaborate route to the toasted-sugar flavour.

cocktails.caption: Nostalgic · Fruity · Tangy
cocktails.rationale: Blackberry liqueur arrives first over gin and lemon, with balsamic in the drizzle. Nostalgic belongs to the scent-led return to a remembered place.

cocktails.caption: Enigmatic · Bittersweet · Herbal
cocktails.rationale: Campari and two vermouths keep bitter and sweet level, with bay leaf in the gin build. Enigmatic evokes recognising something before explaining it.

cocktails.caption: Audacious · Smoky · Sparkling
cocktails.rationale: Bacon-washed bourbon brings smoke beside maple; dry sparkling cider lengthens it. Audacious fits making an unconventional drink by doing the work yourself.

cocktails.caption: Adventurous · Smoky · Zesty
cocktails.rationale: Mezcal meets grapefruit, lime, honey and sparkling water. Adventurous reflects bringing a place's taste home to share.

cocktails.caption: Steadfast · Fruity · Spiced
cocktails.rationale: Rich plum syrup adds fruit to a blended-malt Scotch Old-Fashioned with aromatic bitters. Steadfast comes from keeping the way back in mind.

cocktails.caption: Spellbinding · Tropical · Spiced
cocktails.rationale: Three rums, lime and grapefruit meet cinnamon, clove and anise accents. Spellbinding evokes the Zombie's intricate construction, with its coded mix made legible.

cocktails.caption: Generous · Bittersweet · Fizzy
cocktails.rationale: Equal measures of rye and sweet vermouth are lengthened with soda and finished with bitters. Generous reflects sharing the weight rather than a large serve.

cocktails.caption: Optimistic · Fruity · Zesty
cocktails.rationale: Bourbon meets fresh lemon, orange and pomegranate, with seltzer and mint. Optimistic belongs to the bright, long drink and the patiently made argument.

cocktails.caption: Adventurous · Piney · Spiced
cocktails.rationale: Stone-pine liqueur, rum and allspice make a hot, aromatic cup. Adventurous evokes choosing the next route after an achievement.

cocktails.caption: Intriguing · Savoury · Rounded
cocktails.rationale: Cold beef broth and sherry give a vodka long drink savoury depth, with orange lifting it. Intriguing fits a less familiar steakhouse drink discovered through practice.

cocktails.caption: Exuberant · Tropical · Nutty
cocktails.rationale: Aged Jamaican rum, lime and curaçao meet toasted-almond orgeat and a big mint branch. Exuberant reflects the storytelling around a lime-forward Mai Tai.

cocktails.caption: Dashing · Dry · Aromatic
cocktails.rationale: A Vesper-like gin-and-vodka drink is bone-dry and lemon-scented, with a small Jamaican-rum addition. Dashing fits the decisive, neatly delivered order.

cocktails.caption: Unexpected · Chocolatey · Tart
cocktails.rationale: Clear crème de cacao supplies chocolate beneath rum, vermouth and lime. Unexpected evokes a quiet-looking drink with a flavour you would not see coming.

cocktails.caption: Roguish · Herbal · Bittersweet
cocktails.rationale: Rye meets dark sorghum sweetness and digestif bitters. Roguish belongs to the grin and the dependable action behind an unreliable promise.

cocktails.caption: Heartening · Fruity · Fizzy
cocktails.rationale: Cherry liqueur and lime make the gin-and-Bénédictine build fruity; soda and bitters finish it. Heartening reflects practical help with no fuss.

cocktails.caption: Resolute · Citrusy · Spiced
cocktails.rationale: Tea-steeped cognac carries orange curaçao, aromatic bitters and a lemon-peel collar. Resolute evokes keeping a considered form when circumstances fray.

cocktails.caption: Ingenious · Zesty · Icy
cocktails.rationale: Rum, lime and sugar make a crushed-ice Daiquiri bowl; makrut leaves add lime scent. Ingenious fits solving the drink with what is available.

cocktails.caption: Gentle · Honeyed · Savoury
cocktails.rationale: Fino sherry supplies dry, yeasty and subtly salty depth; chamomile honey gives body beside two vermouths. Gentle reflects the small, attentive sweetening.

cocktails.caption: Carefree · Fruity · Fizzy
cocktails.rationale: Young red wine and cola make the fruity, bubbly Kalimotxo; matching frozen cubes preserve it. Carefree evokes handing over something made for the pleasure of it.

cocktails.caption: Curious · Fruity · Tingling
cocktails.rationale: Cognac and white Pineau bring grape fruitiness and oak; Sichuan peppercorn adds a faint lip tingle. Curious belongs to the delighted second question.

cocktails.caption: Sunny · Tropical · Zesty
cocktails.rationale: Mango syrup brightens a juniper-spirit sour with fresh lime. Sunny reflects its open fruit character and the unshowy pleasure of getting better.

cocktails.caption: Joyful · Citrusy · Bittersweet
cocktails.rationale: Lemon, Aperol and Amaro Nonino meet bourbon, with salt rounding bitter edges. Joyful fits the bright balance and the spontaneous laugh.

cocktails.caption: Devoted · Fruity · Bittersweet
cocktails.rationale: Jamaican rum and vermouth meet dark orange amaro and a generous orange peel. Devoted reflects affection delivered openly rather than in hints.

cocktails.caption: Hopeful · Malty · Light
cocktails.rationale: A long, still whisky drink pairs Tasmanian malt with a small Scotch addition. Light describes the water-lengthened serve; Hopeful belongs to the reading's possibility.

cocktails.caption: Rustic · Appley · Tart
cocktails.rationale: Aged rum meets sharp, still farmhouse cider and raw apple. Rustic evokes the orchard-like simplicity of the Stone Fence, with no promise of fizz.

cocktails.caption: Convivial · Citrusy · Rounded
cocktails.rationale: Rum, lemon oils, lemon juice and black tea build a shared punch. Convivial comes from the bowl and the care taken the night before.

cocktails.caption: Elegant · Dry · Clean
cocktails.rationale: A measured gin Martini with a proper tablespoon of dry vermouth and lemon peel. Elegant evokes enjoying the ordinary classic without making it austere.

cocktails.caption: Candid · Zesty · Rounded
cocktails.rationale: Bourbon and lemon are sweetened with sugar ground into the squeezed peel. Candid fits the small, useful truth offered kindly.

cocktails.caption: Upbeat · Citrusy · Aromatic
cocktails.rationale: Orange peel and cracked coriander scent a gin-and-vermouth drink with red aromatic bitters. Upbeat belongs to making a grey occasion good anyway.

cocktails.caption: Quirky · Nutty · Tart
cocktails.rationale: Scotch and Irish whiskey meet lemon and almond orgeat; coffee beans sit on top. Quirky reflects taking a small absurdity one step further.

cocktails.caption: Impish · Spiced · Rounded
cocktails.rationale: Rye and aged rum are sweetened with demerara and aromatic bitters, then revealed by cracked ice. Impish comes from the deliberate play in the service.

cocktails.caption: Roguish · Creamy · Smoky
cocktails.rationale: Mezcal, whole egg and milk make a creamy flip; a little mezcal is served separately in the shell. Roguish evokes the joke beside the generous glass.

cocktails.caption: Carefree · Zesty · Aniseed
cocktails.rationale: Rum and lime stay fresh under a tangerine-scented absinthe accent and bitters. Carefree evokes stepping outside the expected routine.

cocktails.caption: Alluring · Roasty · Spiced
cocktails.rationale: Cognac and kirsch meet coffee, cinnamon and cloves, poured through a citrus spiral. Alluring belongs to the slowly revealed, aromatic service.

cocktails.caption: Impish · Appley · Fizzy
cocktails.rationale: Apple brandy and dry vermouth are sweetened lightly and topped with soda. Impish reflects the small prepared trick that makes the room more fun.

cocktails.caption: Outspoken · Fruity · Rounded
cocktails.rationale: Banana liqueur brings the Jamaican rum's fruit character into the open; measured water softens the spirit. Outspoken fits saying the thing plainly.

cocktails.caption: Convivial · Malty · Fruity
cocktails.rationale: Apricot-steeped rye is served beside crisp pilsner. Convivial describes the two-glass encounter; the fruit and malt come from different parts of it.

cocktails.caption: Deadpan · Dry · Fizzy
cocktails.rationale: Rye, lime and sparkling mineral water make an unsweetened Rickey. Deadpan evokes the quiet delivery; Dry means there is no added sugar.

cocktails.caption: Wry · Fruity · Dry
cocktails.rationale: Bourbon and dry vermouth gain just enough pear syrup to balance them. Wry fits a dry-seeming drink with a little sweetness left in it.

cocktails.caption: Welcoming · Fruity · Mellow
cocktails.rationale: Roasted apple, brandy, sugar and water make a soft, cooled fruit drink. Welcoming belongs to the preparation done before the guest arrives.

cocktails.caption: Inspiring · Juicy · Minty
cocktails.rationale: Four fresh citrus juices lead a gin drink sweetened with mint syrup. Inspiring evokes encouraging something another person is still making.

cocktails.caption: Daring · Savoury · Tangy
cocktails.rationale: Tomato, dry sherry, lemon and celery salt give a vodka drink savoury bite. Daring fits the guest's readiness to say yes to a different pleasure.

cocktails.caption: Gallant · Fruity · Spiced
cocktails.rationale: Red wine carries the fruit beside rye, demerara and bitters. Gallant evokes going out of your way; no citrus juice or sour structure is implied.

cocktails.caption: Tender · Silky · Floral
cocktails.rationale: Whisky and whole egg make a rich, silky flip with a faint lavender scent absorbed through the shell. Tender fits the openly affectionate reading.

cocktails.caption: Flirtatious · Floral · Tart
cocktails.rationale: Jasmine-tea syrup makes its flowers literal beside gin, lemon and a little Campari. Flirtatious comes from the half-joking invitation around it.

cocktails.caption: Alluring · Herbal · Silky
cocktails.rationale: Gin, shochu and blanc vermouth are stirred with shiso and strained clear. Alluring evokes the quiet depth behind an easy first conversation.

cocktails.caption: Tempting · Earthy · Bittersweet
cocktails.rationale: Beetroot-steeped sweet vermouth adds earthy sweetness beneath rye and curaçao. Tempting comes from the invitation to leave the polite evening together.

cocktails.caption: Lovable · Honeyed · Zesty
cocktails.rationale: Bourbon, lemon and honey make a direct Gold Rush. Lovable reflects the unshowy care of a familiar, dependable drink.

cocktails.caption: Seductive · Tropical · Tart
cocktails.rationale: Pineapple and pomegranate meet strong white rum and fresh lime, with thyme in the syrup. Seductive evokes the deliberate, vivid construction.

cocktails.caption: Romantic · Minty · Icy
cocktails.rationale: Bourbon and rich syrup sit under a large mint bouquet on pounded ice. Romantic belongs to the Julep's ode and the remembered detail offered back.

cocktails.caption: Enchanting · Aniseed · Spiced
cocktails.rationale: Sweet and dry Spanish anise spirits turn hazy when shaken; aromatic bitters add spice. Enchanting reflects the quiet work that makes someone else's night.

cocktails.caption: Generous · Zesty · Herbal
cocktails.rationale: Gin and vodka meet lemon, rosemary syrup and soda, with orange seasoning. Generous evokes making more of a request than the guest expected.

cocktails.caption: Intriguing · Mellow · Fruity
cocktails.rationale: Light grain whisky, blanc vermouth and a teaspoon of calvados make a rounded stirred drink. Intriguing reflects a small adjustment that reveals another possibility.

cocktails.caption: Hopeful · Floral · Tangy
cocktails.rationale: Young Folle Blanche Armagnac adds flowers beside cognac; green-gooseberry syrup supplies the tang. Hopeful belongs to saving something while accepting a change.

cocktails.caption: Buoyant · Fruity · Fizzy
cocktails.rationale: Strawberry-lemon cordial, blended Scotch and soda build a bright, expanding highball. Buoyant evokes the idea that grows beyond its first maker.

cocktails.caption: Mesmerising · Earthy · Chocolatey
cocktails.rationale: Beetroot bourbon, tawny port and clear cacao liqueur arrive in separate layers. Mesmerising comes from seeing how the trick works and still watching it.

cocktails.caption: Magnetic · Dry · Citrusy
cocktails.rationale: Freezer-cold vodka meets a little dry vermouth and freshly grated lemon zest. Magnetic reflects the intense, spare impression of the drink and its quiet reading.

cocktails.caption: Mischievous · Bittersweet · Sparkling
cocktails.rationale: Bourbon, orange liqueur and bitters meet dry champagne over a sugar cube. Mischievous belongs to the sweetness changing the drink as the cube dissolves.

cocktails.caption: Dazzling · Smoky · Steamy
cocktails.rationale: Islay and Irish whiskies meet demerara, lemon peel and hot water. Dazzling evokes the performer's craft; Steamy is the served temperature, not a health claim.

cocktails.caption: Assured · Funky · Tangy
cocktails.rationale: Pungent Batavia arrack meets a sweet-sour Seville-orange shrub and still water. Assured fits a drink assembled to hold its intended balance.

cocktails.caption: Intriguing · Herbal · Silky
cocktails.rationale: Young grappa meets sweet blanc vermouth scented with fig leaf. Herbal refers to leaf and vermouth, not fig fruit; Intriguing evokes seeing value in an overlooked part.

cocktails.caption: Gentle · Gingery · Fizzy
cocktails.rationale: Cognac and pale dry ginger ale are poured around a long lemon-peel spiral. Gentle reflects the drink's rounded long form and the considerate gesture.

cocktails.caption: Unconventional · Floral · Rounded
cocktails.rationale: Unpeated Speyside malt gains elderflower beside orange bitters. Unconventional comes from entering on your own terms; Floral is the actual liqueur accent.

cocktails.caption: Daring · Fruity · Bittersweet
cocktails.rationale: Sloe gin and lemon meet dry gin and a small Cynar addition. Daring reflects the willing leap; sweet fruit and bitter seasoning remain both perceptible.

cocktails.caption: Defiant · Earthy · Herbal
cocktails.rationale: Palm-sap spirit and gin meet sweet vermouth and orange oils. Earthy comes from the named spirit's sourced tasting description; Defiant belongs to the rule challenged.

cocktails.caption: Uncompromising · Herbal · Rounded
cocktails.rationale: Armagnac is seasoned with yellow Chartreuse, bitters and a small syrup measure. Uncompromising evokes keeping the thing worth keeping rather than reflexively refusing it.

cocktails.caption: Irreverent · Zesty · Fizzy
cocktails.rationale: Aged rum, cola, lime and bitters make a familiar long drink with its bite kept in. Irreverent fits puncturing the shared pretence.

cocktails.caption: Liberating · Dry · Herbal
cocktails.rationale: Dry white wine takes bay-leaf scent overnight, then becomes a light spritzer. Liberating evokes choosing your own way; there is no added sugar.

cocktails.caption: Provocative · Fruity · Bold
cocktails.rationale: Young grappa is sweetened with Nebbiolo wine syrup and orange bitters. Provocative fits giving the once-dismissed spirit the central place in the drink.

cocktails.caption: Loyal · Rounded · Spiced
cocktails.rationale: Canadian whisky meets measured maple syrup, a little curaçao and bitters. Loyal reflects knowing where you stand; Rounded comes from the controlled sweetening.

cocktails.caption: Audacious · Fruity · Tart
cocktails.rationale: Rye and triple sec meet lemon and perfumed quince paste. Audacious fits recognising and giving form to something before it has a familiar name.

cocktails.caption: Contrarian · Nutty · Velvety
cocktails.rationale: Amaretto brings the almond-like flavour; bourbon, lemon and sherry vinegar balance it under egg-white foam. Contrarian evokes questioning the easy verdict on a sweet bottle.

cocktails.caption: Welcoming · Roasty · Earthy
cocktails.rationale: Espresso and roasted-parsnip syrup are shaken with brandy. Welcoming evokes the open invitation; roast and root flavours give it depth beyond plain coffee.

cocktails.caption: Unassuming · Herbal · Rounded
cocktails.rationale: Liquorice-root syrup draws out a botanical note in juniper-led gin, with aromatic bitters. Unassuming belongs to a familiar-looking drink with a quietly distinctive skill.

cocktails.caption: Spirited · Citrusy · Tart
cocktails.rationale: Blanco tequila, triple sec and lime make a Margarita, lifted with grapefruit peel. Spirited evokes making your own opening rather than the alcohol's strength alone.

cocktails.caption: Gutsy · Fruity · Spiced
cocktails.rationale: Apple brandy joins rye in a vermouth-and-bitters drink. Gutsy belongs to the willingness to help before knowing the whole job.

cocktails.caption: Carefree · Zesty · Icy
cocktails.rationale: Cachaça meets lime pieces, coarse sugar and cracked ice. Carefree evokes enjoying the uncomplicated pleasure of a Caipirinha without dressing it up.

cocktails.caption: Cheeky · Bitter · Grapefruity
cocktails.rationale: Malört and frozen grapefruit supply a pronounced bitter-tart profile, rounded with maple and salt. Cheeky evokes the willing prank, without promising a gentle drink.

cocktails.caption: Affectionate · Fruity · Rounded
cocktails.rationale: Amber rum and sweet vermouth meet lemon and a soft brandied peach. Affectionate belongs to making time for an ordinary ingredient to become someone's first choice.

cocktails.caption: Lovable · Smoky · Bittersweet
cocktails.rationale: Mezcal meets orange marmalade for both sugar and bitter peel. Lovable comes from the unpretentious marmalade-jar gesture; the drink remains spirit-forward.

cocktails.caption: Irresistible · Zesty · Sparkling
cocktails.rationale: Gin, lemon and syrup are lengthened with brut champagne. Irresistible evokes the charm of asking successfully for just one exception.

cocktails.caption: Empowering · Fruity · Tart
cocktails.rationale: Apple brandy, pomegranate grenadine and measured lime or lemon make a fruit-led sour. Empowering comes from the reading's shared practical knowledge, not an alcohol effect.

cocktails.caption: Familiar · Fruity · Herbal
cocktails.rationale: Sloe gin and dry gin meet dry vermouth, with the gin split adjusted to the bottle's sweetness. Familiar evokes the remembered advice behind the repeatable recipe.

cocktails.caption: Gracious · Citrusy · Rounded
cocktails.rationale: Cognac and sweet vermouth are scented with mandarin liqueur and peel. Gracious comes from letting the conversation finish before delivering the drink.

cocktails.caption: Polished · Citrusy · Tart
cocktails.rationale: Bourbon, lemon and curaçao form a Daisy with a little dry vermouth and soda. Polished reflects the deliberate finish and care offered on another's behalf.

cocktails.caption: Elegant · Zesty · Fruity
cocktails.rationale: A vodka-and-lemon sour enters a glass coated with dry apricot eau-de-vie. Elegant comes from preserving the old gesture while changing the drink around it.

cocktails.caption: Noble · Fruity · Tart
cocktails.rationale: A lemon-and-bourbon sour sits beneath a float of dry red wine. Noble evokes the place kept for others; the wine gives the fruit at the opening sip.

cocktails.caption: Opulent · Herbal · Luscious
cocktails.rationale: Dry vermouth and gin meet sweet Tokaji wine and orange bitters. Luscious refers to the wine's rich sweetness; Opulent evokes asking for the version you truly want.

cocktails.caption: Charismatic · Fruity · Minty
cocktails.rationale: Raspberry-cumin syrup, lime and mint make a vivid vodka drink on crushed ice. Charismatic comes from inviting others into the next small choice.

cocktails.caption: Magnetic · Fruity · Spiced
cocktails.rationale: Fresh pineapple is strained out of a rye-and-vermouth drink but leaves its taste beside bitters. Magnetic reflects attention that remains after the gesture.

cocktails.caption: Majestic · Citrusy · Tart
cocktails.rationale: Rye and a little rum meet orange juice sharpened with citrus acids. Majestic evokes the long view carried by a substantial, bright sour.

cocktails.caption: Rebellious · Fruity · Fizzy
cocktails.rationale: Pimm's keeps strawberry, cucumber and mint, while Peychaud's joins it beside lemon and soda. Rebellious belongs to letting the new idea into an existing structure.

cocktails.caption: Diplomatic · Spiced · Silky
cocktails.rationale: Rye and cognac share a stirred vermouth drink, with cardamom and Bénédictine. Diplomatic evokes bringing both sides in without disguising either spirit.

cocktails.caption: Composed · Malty · Rounded
cocktails.rationale: Blended Scotch is sweetened with a little barley-malt syrup and aromatic bitters. Composed fits hearing the argument through before reaching a decision.

cocktails.caption: Encouraging · Zesty · Herbal
cocktails.rationale: Mint and tarragon are shaken with gin and lemon, then finished with soda. Encouraging belongs to the invitation to discover what the other person now knows.

cocktails.caption: Ingenious · Toasty · Spiced
cocktails.rationale: Popcorn-steeped demerara syrup gives a bourbon Old-Fashioned a toasted grain accent. Ingenious evokes the hidden construction that makes the finished thing work.

cocktails.caption: Reflective · Malty · Rounded
cocktails.rationale: Old-style genever keeps its malt character over a small brandy base, with syrup and bitters. Reflective comes from looking behind a neat explanation.

cocktails.caption: Contemplative · Roasty · Bold
cocktails.rationale: Barrel-proof rye gives the opening Old-Fashioned its presence; the coffee block adds roast as it melts. Contemplative belongs to the drink's unfolding over time.

cocktails.caption: Luminous · Fruity · Tart
cocktails.rationale: Pisco, orange liqueur and blanc vermouth meet white verjus. Luminous evokes a clear, precise drink; the grapes' acid supplies its actual tartness.

cocktails.caption: Witty · Fruity · Velvety
cocktails.rationale: Raspberry and red-wine syrup deepen a gin sour beneath egg-white froth. Witty fits a soft-looking drink with an adult fruit-and-wine depth.

cocktails.caption: Discerning · Nutty · Herbal
cocktails.rationale: Scotch, vermouth and two sherries are finished with sage. Nutty describes oloroso's aroma, not a nut ingredient; Discerning reflects its layered sensory attention.

cocktails.caption: Revelatory · Tangy · Spiced
cocktails.rationale: Two different whiskies called rye meet tamarind water, demerara and bitters. Revelatory comes from the change in how the familiar name is understood.

cocktails.caption: Resolute · Fruity · Rich
cocktails.rationale: Ruby and tawny port meet strong black tea, which adds a drying edge to sweet wine. Resolute fits holding a carefully examined view; the drink is not labelled dry.

cocktails.caption: Easygoing · Herbal · Fizzy
cocktails.rationale: Blanco tequila is lengthened with soda and scented with oregano on the ice. Easygoing evokes letting the plain pleasure stand without joining the argument.

cocktails.caption: Curious · Vanilla · Fizzy
cocktails.rationale: Unpeated Scotch and soda gain a measured touch of vanilla extract. Curious belongs to making one observable change and recording what it does.
